hw-from-phenotype.def: Estimating allele frequencies from phenotype counts: the recessive phenotype frequency equals q², so q = √(recessive frequency) and p = 1 − q. This works only if the population is assumed to be in Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.

carrier-frequency.def: The expected frequency of heterozygotes, 2pq, who carry one copy of a recessive allele without showing its phenotype.

hw-chi-square.def: A chi-square test comparing observed genotype counts with the counts p²N, 2pqN and q²N expected under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, using allele frequencies calculated from the same sample.

allele-change.def: A change in p or q between generations, the signature of evolution in a population; calculated from genotype or phenotype counts at each time point.
